book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: 1 Timoti Nalob̃ulat napisulan na-vǝha-sual-an aPol totosi van hǝn aTimoti

content: Alat lotoil a m̃o mai natikon gail
Egai bogai nakelean nakitinan sua: “Avan ideh b̃elǝŋon b̃egǝm vi vanuan na-il-a-m̃o-an sua hǝn alat siYesu, elǝŋon nauman sua tovoi.”

Nǝvanuan na-il-a-m̃o-an imaiegai tia ke: ikad nab̃oruan tonor ŋai len nǝhon nǝvanuan gail, etǝgau gat nǝmauran nǝlahan tokade mai asoan tosua ŋai, sagol tǝmǝhav hǝn natideh, etǝgau gat nǝlon gabag, ikad nǝnauan tovoi. Ehǝhaṽur hǝn nametb̃os gail lǝb̃eb̃is lohoim san ale kǝtkǝta tǝban galito. Ikad namitisau hǝn nap̃usanan.
Satǝrog, sagol nasǝnahan be ikad naṽide tomǝdmǝdau, saṽitṽituh mai salǝŋon masuṽ hǝn nǝvat.
Iwol hǝn nǝbathudud san ivoi, hǝn anatun gail lǝb̃esǝsǝloŋ husuri, gol nǝsa tokele len nahǝhaṽuran.
(Avan ideh asike b̃elǝboi b̃iwol hǝn nǝbathudud san, gai tekǝtkǝta tǝban alat siGot mabe?)
Savi avan sua tomadhapair van hǝn aGot. B̃imagenan, hum ma b̃ipatpat gai mǝhat ale aGot tipansem gai hum natǝmat.
Len nǝnauan silat lǝsǝkad nadǝlomian, ikad nab̃oruan tovoi hǝn asike nahurun b̃isa len nǝholito mai asike b̃iteh len nǝhai tata setǝmat.
Natikon gail am lumaiegai tia ke: lunor len nǝnauan sinǝvanuan gail, lǝsasum̃an nahit togǝgel hǝn gai, lǝsatǝrog, lǝsalǝŋon masuṽ hǝn natit lotogǝgǝras hǝn lǝb̃ikade.
Len nǝlolit top̃arp̃ar lotǝgau gat nakitinan hǝn nadǝlomian aGot tovǝhoti.
Hǝn gǝb̃itabtabuh len avan ideh hum natikon, gimasbunus lǝboi galit bai, beti avan ideh asike b̃isab̃ natideh tosa len galito, riŋ galito hǝn lǝb̃ekǝtkǝta tǝban nǝvanuan gail hum natikon gail.
Imagenan, nǝbareab salit lumaiegai tia ke: lukad nab̃oruan tovoi len nǝhon nǝvanuan gail, lǝsasor mǝdas nab̃oruan sivan ideh, lǝsagol tǝmǝhav hǝn natideh, lutah mai aGot len natit p̃isi lotogolgole.
Hum notokele husur natikon gail, lumaiegai tia ke: lotǝgau gat nǝlahan lotokade mai asoalit tosua ŋai, luwol hǝn anatulit gail ivoi mai alat lototoh len naim salito.
Husur alat lotokǝtkǝta tǝban nǝvanuan gail tovoi, hum natikon gail, dereh legǝm vi vanuan tonor masuṽ len nǝnauan sinǝvanuan gail, ale leil gǝgat tidaŋ len nadǝlomian len aKristo aYesu.
Nuvatvat viri ke asike idareh negǝm hǝn gaiug. Be nutos nakelean galegai van hǝn gaiug hǝn ke,

nǝb̃edǝdas nǝb̃egǝm tutut, gaiug gelǝboi naṽide, nǝvanuan gail limaskade len nǝbathudud siGot. Nǝbathudud enan evi alat siYesu, siGot tovi nǝkadun nǝmauran, lotovi narivbet mai nǝpaudesen hǝn nakitinan.
Sǝkad nǝ-lon-uri-an. Datup̃aŋ len nǝbathukitinan dattokad nadǝlomian lan. AGot evǝhoti maiegai ke:

content.text: Gai evisi tia, ikad niben nǝvanuan,
nǝvanuan nadǝlomian lukel uri mai naluṽoh gail len naut totiltile,
len navile a pan kavkav nǝvanuan gail lukad nadǝlomian lan,
ale aGot ilavi vi mǝhat vi lan namǝnas.
